what: Natural-language definitions of the 77 BANKING77 intents, one per label, as the Jev (teacher) experiment published them. This is the option-text material of arm B and arm C of #T-option-text: without it the arm is not reproducible, and a definition somebody invented in a turn is not a source.
transform: none — the upstream file is stored byte for byte; `data/taxonomy.py` verifies the sha256 before returning it and never rewrites it
usage_why: these definitions come from the experiment we are comparing ourselves against, so putting them into a training mixture would be training on the reference protocol. Arm B and arm C are forward-only reads of an existing checkpoint (#T-option-text); no gradient ever sees this file.

license_evidence.file: sources/DATA_LICENSE in the same repository and revision
license_evidence.covers: the BANKING77 source data vendored in that repository, which these definitions were written from (its PROTOCOL.md: 'Official PolyAI dataset, pinned commit and file hashes in sources/data_manifest.json; CC-BY-4.0' and 'The 10,003 training messages are the only source of taxonomy definitions and examples')

license_caveat: the repository has NO root LICENSE file: the CC-BY-4.0 above is the licence its authors declared for the data the definitions derive from, not an explicit licence grant on `configs/descriptions.json` itself. It is redistributed here, unmodified and attributed, as a citation of a published experimental configuration, pinned to the commit above. If the author declares a different licence, this file has to be revisited — that is why the caveat is in the card and not only in a commit message.
attribution: Simon Mesmith, 'Experiment 003: Jev on BANKING77' (jev-banking77-experiment), configs/descriptions.json, commit 5cac4ff7783a4cfc0badba4124a309dd2a2b9862

upstream_protocol.says: all 77 official options in a single Choice question; preserve the original labels; natural-language definitions based only on training data; the selected variant was `retrieved24` — the same definitions plus up to 24 BM25-retrieved training examples, at most four per class
upstream_protocol.why_it_matters: R8 — the definitions are only half of the teacher's input protocol; the retrieved examples are the other half, and they are what arm C prices against a 256-token window

examples_source.what: the labelled examples arm C retrieves are NOT in this file: they are BANKING77 train rows
examples_source.support_pool: every train row whose sample id is NOT in the sealed dev cut (artifacts/splits/T-eval-cardinality-banking77-dev/manifest.json), minus any row whose normalised text equals the query's — the teacher excludes normalised-text duplicates of a held-out message from its retrieval support too
examples_source.retrieval: BM25 over word unigrams and adjacent word pairs, k1=1.5, b=0.75 — the algorithm PROTOCOL.md declares; deterministic, no seed, reimplemented in `eval/optiontext.py` (the teacher's own implementation is not vendored)
